segments.source: Sava lucra la masa rabatabilă. Marea Auzire îi trimisese dosarele Vaorului în straturi separate: populație oficială, consum estimat, cereri de hrană, decese, migrații. Datele nu se potriveau nici măcar când excludea camerele abandonate. Copiii ascunși lăsau urme în tot ce consumau, dar nu apăreau în nimic din ceea ce li se acorda.
segments.translation: Sava worked at the folding table. The Great Hearing had sent her Vaor’s files in separate layers: official population, estimated consumption, food requests, deaths, migrations. The data did not match even when she excluded the abandoned chambers. The hidden children left traces in everything they consumed, but appeared in none of what they were granted.

segments.source: — Optzeci de mii? întrebă Oru, privind peste umărul ei.
segments.translation: “Eighty thousand?” Oru asked, looking over her shoulder.

segments.source: — Cel puțin. Poate o sută douăzeci.
segments.translation: “At least. Perhaps a hundred and twenty.”

segments.source: — Cum ascunzi un oraș în alt oraș?
segments.translation: “How do you hide one city inside another?”

segments.source: — Nu-l ascunzi de cei care locuiesc acolo. Îl ascunzi de cel care numără de la distanță.
segments.translation: “You don’t hide it from the people who live there. You hide it from the one counting at a distance.”

segments.source: Taren își întoarse o velă spre ei.
segments.translation: Taren turned one sail towards them.

segments.source: — Și dacă Daran nu minte despre recolte?
segments.translation: “And what if Daran isn’t lying about the harvests?”

segments.source: — A mințit despre oameni, spuse Sava.
segments.translation: “He lied about the people,” Sava said.

segments.source: — Nu este răspuns.
segments.translation: “That isn’t an answer.”

segments.source: — Este motiv să verificăm totul.
segments.translation: “It’s a reason to check everything.”

segments.source: Oru atinse harta rețelei. Conductele principale ale Vaorului apăreau ca niște nervuri subțiri, multe cu randament scăzut.
segments.translation: Oru touched the network map. Vaor’s main pipes appeared as thin veins, many with low yields.

segments.source: — Pierderea nu poate veni numai de la corpurile în plus. Debitul cade înainte să intre în zonele locuite.
segments.translation: “The loss can’t come only from the extra bodies. The flow drops before it reaches the inhabited areas.”

segments.source: — Animalele despre care vorbea Daran?
segments.translation: “The animals Daran was talking about?”

segments.source: — Sau rădăcini bolnave. Sau furt. Sau cineva mută nutrientul în camerele declarate goale.
segments.translation: “Or diseased roots. Or theft. Or someone is diverting nutrient into the chambers declared empty.”

segments.source: Taren își luă hrana din nou.
segments.translation: Taren picked up his food again.

segments.source: — Aceeași explicație poate hrăni și copii, și saryxi.
segments.translation: “The same explanation can feed both children and saryxes.”

segments.source: Sava se opri din lucru. Nemi nu trebuia să audă. Din adăpost, fetița spuse:
segments.translation: Sava stopped working. Nemi was not meant to hear. From the shelter, the little girl said:

segments.source: — Știu ce este un saryx.
segments.translation: “I know what a saryx is.”

segments.source: — Tocmai aceasta este problema, răspunse Sava.
segments.translation: “That is precisely the problem,” Sava replied.

segments.source: La schimbarea ciclului, un servitor al Casei Veyr aduse cină și un mesaj: Daran îl invita pe Taren în vagonul provincial. Taren refuză. După zece minute, Daran veni el.
segments.translation: At the change of cycle, a servant of House Veyr brought dinner and a message: Daran was inviting Taren to the provincial carriage. Taren declined. Ten minutes later, Daran came himself.

segments.source: Stăpânul Vaorului nu părea ofensat de spațiul îngust. Se așeză pe podea, între geanta de unelte a lui Oru și adăpostul lui Nemi, iar mantia lui rigidă ocupă jumătate din compartiment.
segments.translation: The lord of Vaor did not seem offended by the cramped space. He sat on the floor between Oru’s tool bag and Nemi’s shelter, his stiff cloak taking up half the compartment.

segments.source: — În Casa mea, spuse el, un invitat care refuză masa sugerează că gazda vrea să-l otrăvească.
segments.translation: “In my House,” he said, “a guest who refuses a meal suggests that the host wants to poison him.”

segments.source: — În Ivarra, un stăpân care vine neinvitat sugerează același lucru, răspunse Taren.
segments.translation: “In Ivarra, a lord who comes uninvited suggests the same thing,” Taren replied.

segments.source: Daran râse. Nemi scoase capul dintre pături ca să-l privească.
segments.translation: Daran laughed. Nemi poked her head between the blankets to look at him.

segments.source: — Tu ești cel cu orașul rece? întrebă.
segments.translation: “Are you the one with the cold city?” she asked.

segments.source: — Eu sunt cel care încearcă să-l țină cald.
segments.translation: “I’m the one trying to keep it warm.”

segments.source: — Mama spune că ai mințit despre copii.
segments.translation: “Mother says you lied about the children.”

segments.source: Sava închise ochii. Daran își întoarse atenția spre fetiță.
segments.translation: Sava closed her eyes. Daran turned his attention to the little girl.

segments.source: — Mama ta are dreptate.
segments.translation: “Your mother is right.”

segments.source: — De ce?
segments.translation: “Why?”

segments.source: — Pentru că adevărul trimis la Ivarra se întorcea cu mai puțină hrană decât plecase.
segments.translation: “Because the truth sent to Ivarra came back with less food than it had left with.”

segments.source: — Asta nu are sens.
segments.translation: “That doesn’t make sense.”

segments.source: — Vei descoperi că multe lucruri ale adulților sunt făcute tocmai ca să nu aibă sens pentru copii.
segments.translation: “You’ll discover that many adult things are made precisely so they won’t make sense to children.”

segments.source: Sava interveni:
segments.translation: Sava intervened:

segments.source: — Nu folosi copilul meu ca tribună.
segments.translation: “Don’t use my child as a platform.”

segments.source: — Nu o folosesc. Ea pune întrebări mai bune decât inspectorii.
segments.translation: “I’m not using her. She asks better questions than the inspectors.”

segments.source: Daran îi întinse lui Taren o placă. Pe ecran se vedeau trei atacuri asupra transporturilor Vaorului: siluete mascate, lumini termice, fugă haotică. În ultimul cadru, un muncitor rămânea pe podea.
segments.translation: Daran held out a slate to Taren. The screen showed three attacks on Vaor’s transports: masked figures, thermal lights, chaotic flight. In the final frame, a worker remained on the floor.

segments.source: — Acesta a murit acum o lună, spuse Daran. Niciun agent al Casei nu a tras. Niciun hoț nu fusese ucis până atunci. Ceva s-a schimbat.
segments.translation: “This one died a month ago,” Daran said. “No House agent fired. No thief had been killed before then. Something has changed.”

segments.source: — Armele, spuse Taren.
segments.translation: “The weapons,” Taren said.

segments.source: — Și oamenii care le folosesc.
segments.translation: “And the people using them.”

segments.source: — Cine le-a dat?
segments.translation: “Who supplied them?”

segments.source: — Dacă aș ști, nu te-aș fi lăsat să refuzi masa.
segments.translation: “If I knew, I wouldn’t have let you refuse the meal.”

segments.source: Sava luă placa. Metadatele fuseseră curățate, dar nu complet. O serie de identificatori proveneau din inventarul central.
segments.translation: Sava took the slate. The metadata had been scrubbed, but not completely. A series of identifiers came from the central inventory.

segments.source: — Aceste proiectile au fost fabricate în Ivarra.
segments.translation: “These projectiles were manufactured in Ivarra.”

segments.source: — Aproape toate lucrurile capabile să ne rănească sunt fabricate acolo, spuse Daran. Unele sub numele de instrument medical.
segments.translation: “Almost everything capable of hurting us is manufactured there,” Daran said. “Some of it under the name of medical instruments.”

segments.source: Înainte să plece, se opri lângă adăpostul lui Nemi.
segments.translation: Before leaving, he stopped beside Nemi’s shelter.

segments.source: — Când trenul urcă la suprafață, nu te uita numai spre cer, îi spuse. Privește linia dintre lumină și întuneric. Acolo trăim.
segments.translation: “When the train rises to the surface, don’t look only at the sky,” he told her. “Look at the line between light and darkness. That’s where we live.”

segments.source: — De ce nu construiți mai aproape de lumină?
segments.translation: “Why don’t you build closer to the light?”

segments.source: — Pentru că ne arde.
segments.translation: “Because it burns us.”

segments.source: — Mai aproape de întuneric?
segments.translation: “Closer to the darkness?”

segments.source: — Pentru că ne îngheață.
segments.translation: “Because it freezes us.”

segments.source: Nemi se gândi.
segments.translation: Nemi thought about it.

segments.source: — Atunci orașul tău nu are unde să fugă.
segments.translation: “Then your city has nowhere to run.”

segments.source: Daran o privi o clipă prea lungă.
segments.translation: Daran looked at her a moment too long.

segments.source: — Exact.
segments.translation: “Exactly.”

segments.source: Trenul încetini la puțin timp după plecarea lui Daran, dar vibrația nu semăna cu frânarea unui nod de compensare. Mai întâi dispăru huruitul regulat de sub podea. Apoi o lovitură surdă trecu prin vagoane, urmată de o tăcere atât de completă încât Sava auzi lichidul mișcându-se în recipientul lui Nemi.
segments.translation: The train slowed shortly after Daran left, but the vibration was nothing like braking at a compensation node. First the regular rumble beneath the floor disappeared. Then a dull blow passed through the carriages, followed by a silence so complete that Sava heard the liquid moving in Nemi’s container.

segments.source: Fetița ieși din adăpost.
segments.translation: The little girl came out of the shelter.

segments.source: — Asta ce este?
segments.translation: “What’s that?”

segments.source: Oru își lipi degetele de podea. Așteptă. Nimic.
segments.translation: Oru pressed his fingers to the floor. He waited. Nothing.

segments.source: — Nu știu.
segments.translation: “I don’t know.”
